message: So, there I was, enjoying a cozy evening at home when suddenly, the lights flickered and went out. My first instinct? Fumbling around for the flashlight I was sure I had… somewhere! After a good ten minutes of searching in the dark, I finally found it—batteries dead. 😅 Lesson learned: I now keep a power bank charged and a lantern ready to go. It’s all about those little comforts when the unexpected happens! What’s your go-to tip for staying comfy during a blackout?
